test_title: PYST 33: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'TELEVISION' is written as 'UDMDWKQKMP' and 'PUNISHMENT' is written as 'QTOHTJKGLV'. How will 'HELICOPTER' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (1) is added to and subtracted from the position value alternately according to the English alphabetic series.

 So,

 
• 'TELEVISION' is written as 'UDMDWKQKMP'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fdd23abac302f10840eb90dedb52d86f1764d64de8399902e6c36c8ad450064.png] 

And,

 
• 'PUNISHMENT' is written as 'QTOHTJKGLV'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31ce3249859a995af372b34d9439b9538692ddb9a544dfc524c22412ceee2799.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'HELICOPTER' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2c551983d78b0695c0de8aa7378a5ad43e4e05ca9db2d93df3f231b5f267763.png] 

Hence, "**IDMHDQNVCT**" is the correct answer.
